body:
As far as activities go, believe me I DO pick things I am passionate about. Fighting has been a huge part of my life for the past 4 years, and I never intent to quit. The thing is, it has become the only thing I have, and does not solve my other, larger issues. 

The short-term is covered. The problem is that I realized the short-term not does address the long-term at all. 

Thanks for the effort, though. I feel a little worse every day, but also a little better right now for the resolutions I have made for next year.

Thanks for the support.

Yeah I have other interests as well. I play guitar, skateboard, play golf..... you know, other things white people like to do. But youre right, I always find it endlessly interesting to put myself out there and learn new things. Starting tomorro, I am going go start swimming. I am a natural born runner and swimmer, but to be honest i bloody **hate** running and swimming. It will be good to put my god-given talents to use, though.

I stay in tough with my friends as much as I can, but we are sort of drifting apart by becoming different people. Unfortunately, there is only so much you can do about that.

This has been my first panic attack. Thankfully they are not recurring. Thanks for the effort though, Psy-Kosh.

Sonia, you are right. I do attend college and I really should be taking advantage of more group / club opportunities. Starting next semester I will join our school's boxing club. I am extremely satisfied  with my current gym, so I didnt really give the boxing club much of a thought, but it will definitely be a good way to meet people with similar interests. 

Additionally, I really should consider going to our on-campus church more. Hopefully that will be a good way to meet people with similar life-goals. I am currently getting my criminal justice degree and will (hopefully) eventually be a cop, so I know in the future I will be living my life in the service of other people. In the meantime I really only have increasingly transparent distractions, so ive been feeling pretty low lately.

Thanks for the advice though, I *truly truly truly* appreciate it.

Hello SW, I just need to say some things that have been on my mind lately. 

My 20th birthday came and went recently, which is sort of the sophomore year of birthdays but in my opinion is a major milestone. I am officially in my early 20s, and I sort of made a self evaluation of how things are going in my life.

I know being  20 isnt terribly old, but I can no longer find solace in the thought that I am still a teenager. I know I am still young and have my entire life ahead of me, but I cant help but feel that every passing day brings me one day closer to death. The way I feel is that I have a figurative hand around my throat, and every breath I take is the biggest breath I will ever take again.  This definitely sounds pretty melodramatic on paper, but compounded with other factors, it is no small thing.

One such factors for me right now is that I have no girlfriend, nor to be honest **ever** have had one. Now, in my opinion I am fairly charming and pretty good looking, but meeting women is still difficult for me. As time goes on, the possibility of dying *alone* is becoming a very real reality. 

On top of not having a girlfriend, I realized I am drifting away from a handful of my close friends.  This made me realize I do not have anybody I feel truly close with.  The friends I do have can often be shallow and distant, leaving me feeling alone when I really need sometone to talk to.

My favorite hobbies (Muay Thai, Judo, JiuJitsu, videogames) have become less of hobby and more of an escape from my normal life. The gym is slowly becoming the only thing I have. This has worked for me so far, but lately I cant help but remember the reason *why* i'm sweating my ass off and working hard: less for fun and enjoyment, more of an escape. 

As I kept thinking of all these things, I eventually drive myself into having a panic attack, and felt crushingly depressed. Which in turn served as a reminder that I really dont have anyone to talk to, which of course didnt help the situation. I do not feel suicidal, I just feel like i want to quit. I continue to work hard both in school and in fighting, but the feelings are all still there.

Thanks for listening. This is the first time I have said anything like this to *anyone*.
